writtenBefore: any line of the implementation, and before the first run
whyThisFileExists: The owner's acceptance criterion: expected results are recorded and hashed BEFORE the tests run, so a result cannot be produced and then described as what was expected. Prose would not do: these expectations are IMPORTED by the tests, so an expectation and an assertion cannot drift apart.

stages.mustReport: what the detector recorded this claim covers: obligation reference, expected, billed, residual, currency
the succeeded detection task and its append sequence
the candidate row, its dedupe grain, and that it was not a duplicate
the immutable operator review, its decision and that a reason was given
the governed root, its boundary, and the at-risk figure frozen at promotion
the locked baseline, its method and version
that NH has no billing-correction execution mechanism at all
every amount ever observed for this identity and the precedence state, with no corrected figure offered
the evidence rows, their trust classification, and whether a signature was verified
the proof chain and the obligation-identity gate's verdict

executionClass.EXECUTED: real production code ran and wrote the real record

inputClass.SIMULATED: NH or its harness produced the input or the event
inputClass.OBSERVED: NH read a fact out of supplied data
inputClass.ATTESTED: an independent external party, not party to the claim, asserted it
inputClass.NOT_ESTABLISHABLE: the record carries no fact by which this could be decided

evidenceClasses.whyTwoFieldsAndNotOne: A stage can be EXECUTED and SIMULATED at once, and saying only the first half is how a demo gets mistaken for a pilot. Collapsing them would make the stronger word wear the weaker one's guarantee.

globalProperties.property: revenueReturned.established is FALSE for every case in this build
globalProperties.derivedFrom: the evidence receipt and the trust registry carry no field recording WHO HOLDS the signing key, so an NH-held key and a customer-held key are indistinguishable in the record
globalProperties.notDerivedFrom: a string match on the keyId — a naming convention is not a mechanism

globalProperties.property: no monetary field is ever 0 to mean 'not established'
globalProperties.expectedBehaviour: null, with a named reason beside it

globalProperties.property: figures from different ledgers are never summed
globalProperties.expectedBehaviour: every figure carries its ledger tag; totals are per ledger and no grand total exists
the same records yield the same digest; clock values (verifiedAt, ingestedAt) are excluded from the preimage

globalProperties.property: no raw customer identifier reaches the trace
globalProperties.expectedBehaviour: pseudonymous references only, and no validator detail strings

globalProperties.property: the trace reads AuditRead-gated, root-then-boundary, like every other provenance-bearing read
globalProperties.expectedBehaviour: operator 403, author 403, unauthenticated 401, approver 200, unknown case 404 only after authorization

failureScenarios.name: negative residual — a disputed, company-unfavourable figure
failureScenarios.setup: coverage states billed > expected, so residual is negative
failureScenarios.rule: negative is a liability signal — never exposure and never recovered revenue; money the company may owe back is not money it found

failureScenarios.name: duplicate / replay — the same observation twice
failureScenarios.setup: two succeeded observations of one identity carrying the identical amount
failureScenarios.rule: a replay is not a correction and must not double count

failureScenarios.name: account aggregate
failureScenarios.rule: PROVEN may not be assigned at account level

failureScenarios.name: unresolved obligation reference
failureScenarios.setup: coverage states SINGLE_OBLIGATION with a blank obligationRef
failureScenarios.rule: a proof may not be minted for a claim whose subject is unknown

failureScenarios.name: mismatched identity arithmetic
failureScenarios.setup: residual does not equal expected minus billed
failureScenarios.rule: a stamped discrepancy nobody can re-derive is a figure nobody can trace

failureScenarios.name: no double counting across ledgers
failureScenarios.setup: a case carrying an observed exposure, an undecided correction magnitude and a proven figure at once
failureScenarios.expectedBehaviour: three separate figures, each ledger-tagged; no field holds their sum; the trace exposes no grand total
failureScenarios.rule: an understatement and an overstatement are two problems and their sum is zero problems

whatThisSliceDoesNotClaim: that a billing correction was issued — no mechanism exists and none is built here
that money was collected — no independent settlement source has ever signed anything
that any observed amount became Revenue Returned
that a customer can supply these facts — every figure is synthetic
